results.transcript: Good morning! Good morning! Good morning! Welcome to the day in the life of a 32-year-old small business owner who makes coffee for a living. Today's pop-up day, and it's a pretty special one, because we're adding the Malconi E65W Grind by Sink grinder to our bar. I'm really excited because this grinder is a barista's dream that helps simplify and streamline the espresso-making process. It has a built-in scale which allows us to preset the dose and weight we want, and it simply grinds automatically when it recognizes the portafilter and then stops when it's reached its set weight. Because of the technology in the Smellconi Grinder, we're able to be more consistent from shot to shot, quicker in our workflow, and minimize our wasted coffee grounds. It's also helped us dial in our coffee quicker and ensures we're making the best-tasting drinks for each customer. How are you? Good, how are you? Some iced lattes for you, my friend.
